digest.component_or_area: LLM capability resolution and cache settings
propositions: Provider name string matching for capability decisions (native output, prompt caching) fails for Bedrock-hosted Claude because the model string says 'bedrock' not 'anthropic', silently disabling caching and forcing prompted output path

ModelProfile objects exported from pydantic_ai expose standardized capability fields (supports_json_schema_output, prompt_cache_style, supports_thinking) that should be the authoritative source instead of provider-name string prefixes

Lazy model strings (deferred provider construction for optional-SDK vendors like OpenAI/Google) cannot be introspected directly, but pydantic_ai.profiles.* modules provide SDK-free capability records via a resolver registry

Rebar's override table must force Claude (both direct Anthropic and Bedrock-hosted) to PromptedOutput despite upstream's supports_json_schema_output=True, preserving the deliberate tooling choice and existing test contract

Cache settings selection must dispatch on capability type (anthropic vs bedrock vs none) rather than provider name string, and Bedrock cache keys (bedrock_cache_instructions, bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) must be applied for Bedrock-hosted Claude
A new leaf module capabilities.py must encapsulate capability interpretation separate from provider construction to keep providers.py under its 300 LOC size criterion from S1
